Loaded by npm run seed:catalog. refPricePaise is the typical shelf price in paise of the usual pack an Indian shopper asks for; it is AI-estimated (not surveyed), so treat it as a plausible reference, not a quote. Used by the shop simulator and, later, the rupees-saved metric.
